items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And there was Franz Jackson on tenor saxophone.

ctx.x: No, just the alto. And there was Franz Jackson on tenor saxophone. And Dave McRae, who played alto and baritone saxophone. In fact, he could play them all. He played clarinet.
He could play clarinet, but he didn't do any clarinet playing. Dave McRae played the clarinet.
